productName: CEO Medical Plan 5 / CEO Medical Plan (Worldwide) 5

trends.whatProductOffers: Provides a lifetime limit of HK$50,000,000 with an annual limit of HK$20,000,000; the Worldwide version carries US$6,250,000 lifetime and US$2,500,000 annual limits.
exclusionsOrConditions: Limits shown are the plan maximums; individual benefit items still follow the benefits schedule.
Annual deductible choices of 0 / 16,000 / 25,000 / 50,000 (HK$) apply and reduce the reimbursed amount.
Currency of the policy determines which limit set applies.
clientSignalPhrases: worried one big claim uses up the plan
wants lifetime limit not annual only
wants room for cancer treatment over years
clientProfileFit: Families wanting maximum lifetime medical capacity
Clients planning for expensive long-term cancer or dialysis treatment

verificationPrompts: Confirm which limit set applies to the chosen plan version and currency.

trends.whatProductOffers: Covers hospital treatment worldwide, with a Worldwide version including the United States and a standard version covering worldwide excluding the United States; both include global emergency treatment and worldwide emergency assistance.
exclusionsOrConditions: The standard version excludes the United States; US treatment requires the Worldwide version.
Global emergency treatment and assistance services are defined in the benefits schedule and may carry limits.
The extracted text does not state whether elective treatment abroad requires pre-approval.
clientProfileFit: Executives with regional or global responsibilities
trends.talkingPointTemplate: {client_detail} can choose worldwide cover including the US, and keep emergency assistance wherever they travel.
verificationPrompts: Confirm whether US treatment is included in the selected version.
Confirm pre-approval requirements for elective overseas treatment.
sourceEvidence: Geographical Cover: Worldwide / Worldwide excluding the United States
global emergency treatment and worldwide emergency assistance services
trends.notesForReviewer: Overseas treatment approval mechanics not in the extracted text.

trends.whatProductOffers: Guarantees renewal for life without premium loading for claims or health changes, and reduces the selected annual deductible by 10% for every two consecutive claim-free cover years, up to 100%.

keyFigures.label: No-claim deductible discount
keyFigures.condition: per two consecutive claim-free cover years

keyFigures.label: Reset
keyFigures.condition: next cover year after a claim payment

exclusionsOrConditions: The discount applies to the original deductible amount and resets to 0% in the next cover year after a claim payment.
Hospital cash, lower room class cash, day surgery and worldwide emergency assistance claims do not affect eligibility for the discount.
Renewal premium still follows prevailing premium rates, so age-related increases apply.
clientSignalPhrases: doesn't want to pay for claims he won't make
clientProfileFit: Healthy clients choosing a higher deductible to lower premium
trends.talkingPointTemplate: If {client_detail} stays claim-free, the deductible drops 10% every two years and can reach zero.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the deductible choices available and the premium difference between them.
Confirm which benefit payments reset the discount.
sourceEvidence: If no claim is made for two consecutive cover years ... offers a 10% discount on your selected deductible choice in the following cover year. Such discount will accumulate every two consecutive cover years and can reach up to 100%
trends.notesForReviewer: Actual premium figures not in the extracted text.

trends.whatProductOffers: Pays a disability subsidy of HK$5,000 per month for up to 24 months if the insured cannot take care of themselves for at least 6 uninterrupted months, and covers home facility enhancements and therapies after a stroke.

keyFigures.label: Trigger
keyFigures.value: unable to self-care for 6 uninterrupted months

exclusionsOrConditions: The subsidy requires inability to take care of oneself for at least 6 uninterrupted months.
Maximum payout is 24 months of HK$5,000.
Home facility enhancements require approval by occupational therapists.
Extended caring benefits are defined in the benefits schedule and may carry their own limits.
clientSignalPhrases: who pays if I can't work
clientProfileFit: Clients with stroke or cardiovascular family history
Households where the insured is the main caregiver or earner
trends.talkingPointTemplate: If {client_detail} cannot self-care for six months after a stroke, HK$5,000 a month is paid for up to 24 months on top of treatment costs.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the definition of unable to take care of oneself.
Confirm whether the subsidy is payable alongside hospital reimbursement.
Confirm the list of covered home enhancements and therapies.
sourceEvidence: if you become unable to take care of yourself for at least 6 uninterrupted months, we will provide a disability subsidy of HK$5,000 per month to you for up to 24 months
home facility enhancements approved by occupational therapists - widening of corridors, adapting bathroom facilities and purchasing specialised furniture
trends.notesForReviewer: Subsidy is a fixed monthly amount, not an income replacement calculation.
